purpose: HTML style proposal only; no production asset changes

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: One isolated transparent PNG world prop for a Chinese dark fantasy dungeon HTML art proposal.
Primary request: A single ancient relic pedestal, a squat solid worn grey-black stone plinth with a small cluster of weathered smoky pale quartz embedded directly in its cracked top. Crystal fragments feel like excavated mineral relics, not magical neon. Nothing floating.
Style/medium: Detailed realistic hand-painted game environment asset, restrained texture and natural material detail, matching a dark ruined Chinese temple dungeon of cold grey flagstones, old stone stairs, aged iron and tarnished gold accents.
Composition: Lightly elevated three-quarter top-down game camera, see the top and front with one side; entire object including all footings visible. Compact readable single silhouette centered in a square image with 12% transparent padding. No scattered objects separate from pedestal.
Materials: rough chipped ash-grey stone, dark iron band around a small recessed mount, tiny oxidized old gold inlays, subtle mineral facets. Low saturation, muted contrast, soft diffuse cold overhead light with gentle warm reflection. No self-illumination.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha, no scene, no ground plane, no baked background or checkerboard. Preserve fine edges and opaque stone.
Avoid: cartoon, vector flat fill, low-poly, bright blue crystals, purple/pink neon, glow aura, energy rings, floating objects, text, letters, symbols resembling readable script, UI, frame, logo, watermark, multiple asset sheet.
assets.method: built-in image_gen, one independent image per call; byte-for-byte copied; no image postprocessing

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: One isolated transparent PNG world prop for a Chinese dark fantasy dungeon HTML art proposal.
Primary request: An ancient law lectern, a short heavy stone bookstand holding one open thick battered tome. Dark weathered stone stand with subtle aged gold carved cloud pattern accents and a slanted top. The open tome has frayed fibrous parchment sheets, broken corners, muted brown worn cover; pages mostly blank with only very faint indistinct weather stains, absolutely no readable writing.
Style/medium: Detailed realistic hand-painted environment game asset, suited to an ancient ruined Chinese temple dungeon with cold grey stone floor and aged dark bronze ornaments. Low saturation muted materials, grounded tangible weight.
Composition: Lightly elevated three-quarter top-down game camera, visible open page spread and front/one side of pedestal. Entire single object including heavy stepped base and all footings visible. Compact readable silhouette centered in square, 12% transparent edge padding. Book sits on stone, not floating. No loose pages or separate props.
Materials: ash-grey stone chipped along edges, rough mineral texture, tarnished old gold inlay only on a few recessed border details, dirty cream parchment, dark brown leather binding. Soft diffuse cold overhead light, minimal shadow, no self-emission or glows.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha, no scene, no ground plane, no checkerboard or baked background.
Avoid: cartoon, vector flat fill, low-poly, bright gold, blue/purple neon, magical halo, floating runes, luminous pages, readable text, Latin or Chinese writing, letters, numbers, UI, frame, logo, watermark, asset sheet.
assets.method: built-in image_gen, one independent image per call; byte-for-byte copied; no image postprocessing

visual_inspection.relic: Grounded intact pedestal, weathered neutral quartz, no glow or neighboring-object fragments. Quartz highlights are lighter than dungeon stone but remain natural.
visual_inspection.shrine: Grounded octagonal shrine, cold black stone and old bronze. Small warm-white flame plus pale gray wisp retained with partial alpha; at thumbnail size flame remains the strongest focal point.
visual_inspection.law: Whole worn stone lectern and blank ragged tome; no readable script. Parchment gives a broad light area useful for interaction readability.

known_limitations: Not validated in production engine or WeChat device.
Dense old-gold relief details will simplify at in-game sprite sizes.
Objects generated independently; final perceived scale is to be evaluated in HTML scene.

Raw generated alpha contains many near-opaque values of 252/253 and faint edge pixels; source bytes were preserved without thresholding or cleanup. Threshold-128 alpha bounds are recorded to distinguish visible silhouette from faint edge pixels.
